health_factor.short: How much buffer you have before liquidation.
health_factor.detailed: Your gross collateral value divided by your effective debt. Vanna liquidates when health factor reaches 1.1 or below. It moves as prices move.
health_factor.why_it_matters: At or below 1.1 your position can be liquidated. Higher is safer.
health_factor.common_mistake: It is a ratio, not a percentage. A very large number usually means tiny debt versus collateral — healthy, not a bug.

liquidation_threshold.short: The health factor at which liquidation is allowed.
liquidation_threshold.detailed: On Vanna this is 1.1. When HF is at or below 1.1, collateral can be sold to repay debt. Debt limit is roughly gross collateral divided by 1.1.
liquidation_threshold.why_it_matters: Everything on Margin is about staying above this line.
liquidation_threshold.common_mistake: Some protocols show this as a percent LTV. Vanna shows it as a health-factor trigger.

liquidation.short: When protocol sells your collateral to repay debt because HF is too low.
liquidation.detailed: If health factor falls to 1.1 or below, anyone can liquidate your margin account. You lose some collateral; debt is reduced.
liquidation.why_it_matters: Avoid by adding collateral, repaying debt, or reducing leverage when HF falls.

collateral_left.short: How much collateral value you can lose before hitting the liquidation line.
collateral_left.detailed: Roughly the USD cushion between current position and HF = 1.1. Shrinks when collateral prices fall or debt rises.
collateral_left.why_it_matters: A small buffer means a small price move can make you liquidatable.

net_available_collateral.short: Collateral value left after accounting for debt.
net_available_collateral.detailed: Gross collateral minus debt (USD). Shows room you still have in the account.
net_available_collateral.why_it_matters: Low net available means little room to borrow more safely.

total_borrowed.short: How much you currently owe on the margin account.
total_borrowed.detailed: Sum of open debt positions, valued in USD or shown per asset on the page.
total_borrowed.why_it_matters: Debt drives interest and lowers health factor relative to collateral.

borrow_rate.short: Interest rate you pay on borrowed assets.
borrow_rate.detailed: Usually rises with utilization of the lending pool. Accrues over time on your debt.
borrow_rate.why_it_matters: Higher rates mean debt grows faster and HF can fall if you do nothing.

cross_margin_ratio.short: What share of collateral you have borrowed against.
cross_margin_ratio.detailed: Total borrowed value divided by gross collateral, as a percentage (loan-to-value style).
cross_margin_ratio.why_it_matters: Rising LTV means more leverage and lower health factor.

cross_account_leverage.short: How leveraged the margin account is overall.
cross_account_leverage.detailed: Roughly how large your exposure is relative to equity. Higher leverage amplifies gains and losses.
cross_account_leverage.why_it_matters: High leverage makes HF more sensitive to price moves.

utilization.short: Share of a pool that is already borrowed.
utilization.detailed: Borrowed assets divided by supplied assets in that earn pool. Higher util usually means higher borrow APY.
utilization.why_it_matters: Affects rates for suppliers and borrowers.

supply_apy.short: Yield suppliers earn for lending into a pool.
supply_apy.detailed: Annualized supply rate for the Vanna earn pool. Live numbers must come from pool stats tools, not guesses.
supply_apy.why_it_matters: Tells you what you earn for supplying that asset.

vtoken.short: Receipt token for assets you supply to Vanna Earn.
vtoken.detailed: When you lend, you receive vTokens that grow in value as interest accrues. Redeem them to withdraw supply.
vtoken.why_it_matters: Your earn position is tracked as vToken balance, not the raw deposit alone.

exchange_rate.short: How much underlying asset one vToken is worth.
exchange_rate.detailed: Rises as the pool earns interest. Converts between vToken and asset amounts.
exchange_rate.why_it_matters: Explains why redeem amount differs from original deposit over time.

btoken.short: Receipt for supplying into Blend farm reserves.
btoken.detailed: Blend positions are tracked with bTokens / b-rate, separate from Vanna Earn vTokens.
btoken.why_it_matters: Farm Blend is a different venue from Vanna Earn pools.

blend.short: External farm venue for single-asset supply on Stellar.
blend.detailed: Vanna can deploy margin funds into Blend reserves (XLM / USDC). This is Farm, not Vanna Earn. Rates and risks differ from earn pools.
blend.why_it_matters: Asking about Blend APY is a farm/read question; supplying to Blend is a farm write, not margin deposit alone.
blend.common_mistake: Do not confuse Blend USDC (BLUSDC family) with Aquarius AQUSDC — different tokens.

farm.short: Putting capital into external venues (Blend, Aquarius LP, Soroswap) for yield.
farm.detailed: Farm uses your margin smart account free balance or packaged deploy flows. Separate from simple Earn supply from the wallet.
farm.why_it_matters: Different tools, risks, and tokens than Earn.

lp_shares.short: Your share of a liquidity pool (Aquarius / Soroswap).
lp_shares.detailed: When you add liquidity, you receive LP shares. Remove liquidity burns them for the underlying tokens.
lp_shares.why_it_matters: LP positions can face impermanent loss as prices move.

impermanent_loss.short: LP value can lag holding both tokens when prices diverge.
impermanent_loss.detailed: In a constant-product pool, large relative price moves can leave LPs worse than simply holding the assets.
impermanent_loss.why_it_matters: Farm APY must be weighed against IL risk.

slippage.short: How much worse execution you will accept vs quote.
slippage.detailed: Swaps set a min-out floor (often from oracle expected_out and a percent buffer). Too tight and the tx fails; too loose and you accept worse price.
slippage.why_it_matters: Protects you from bad fills on volatile pairs.

oracle_price.short: On-chain price used for collateral and risk.
oracle_price.detailed: Vanna uses an oracle (Reflector-compatible) for USD prices of assets. Margin health and limits use these prices.
oracle_price.why_it_matters: Wrong or stale oracles can misprice risk — protocol uses on-chain feeds, not arbitrary website numbers.

available_liquidity.short: Assets still free in a pool for borrowers to take.
available_liquidity.detailed: Supply minus borrows (roughly). Low liquidity can raise rates or block large borrows.
available_liquidity.why_it_matters: You may not borrow more than available liquidity allows.

pnl.short: Profit or loss on the position over time.
pnl.detailed: On some testnet UI surfaces this may still show a placeholder zero — the assistant will say so when the page marks it as placeholder.
pnl.why_it_matters: Realized PnL needs live accounting; placeholders must not be treated as measured profit.

liquidation_premium.short: Extra incentive paid to liquidators beyond debt repaid.
liquidation_premium.detailed: Protocols often pay liquidators a premium from the liquidated account's collateral. On this testnet UI the value may be a placeholder zero until wiring is complete.
liquidation_premium.why_it_matters: Affects how much collateral a liquidated user loses.

liquidation_fee.short: Protocol fee charged during a liquidation.
liquidation_fee.detailed: A fee taken from the liquidated position in addition to debt repayment. The margin UI may still show a placeholder until live fee accounting is wired.

blusdc.short: Blend-family USDC token on this testnet.
blusdc.detailed: One of three USDC SACs. Margin MCP often maps BLUSDC to symbol USDC. Not the same as AQUSDC or SOUSDC.
blusdc.why_it_matters: Wrong USDC variant fails deposits, LP, or earn pool selection.
blusdc.common_mistake: Aquarius LP needs AQUSDC, not BLUSDC.

aqusdc.short: Aquarius USDC SAC used for Aquarius earn/LP/margin.
aqusdc.detailed: Distinct from BLUSDC and SOUSDC. Use for Aquarius-related actions.
aqusdc.why_it_matters: LP and Aquarius collateral use this token, not Blend USDC.

sousdc.detailed: Distinct from BLUSDC and AQUSDC. Used on Soroswap-related paths.
sousdc.why_it_matters: Picking the wrong USDC variant breaks swaps or earn.
